summary_en: A blue-grey clay cat squashes clay into a flowerpot and plants a sprout, in a Blender EEVEE stop-motion scene with procedural clay materials.
limits_en: Characters are rounded metaball shapes; the hand-pinched feel comes mostly from bump maps and geometric thumbprints, so detail and lighting realism are a little below a real clay animation.
Background props (blue watering can, red mushroom) are simplified; the can silhouette is quite abstract.
Paw-to-clay contact follows positions only, with no physical deformation (fingers do not sink into the clay).
